policy.request: exact normalized tenant and user plus bounded requested channel slugs and group IDs
policy.channel_owner: ChannelReadPort exact slug lookup with inactive channels hidden
policy.channel_truth: the current caller channel is requested and resolves active in the same tenant
policy.no_discovery: unrequested channels are never listed or probed
policy.positive_union: an exact active current channel decides before optional Groups or unavailable trust facts
policy.groups: the historical FORUM-20Q adapter remains exact and is called only after a channel miss
policy.trust: unimplemented trust facts remain typed retryable unavailable when no delivered selector decides
policy.storage_access: the host adapter uses owner ports and performs no direct Channel or Groups entity access
